meta.title: 7 Tourist Scams in Vietnam and How to Avoid Them (Money Switching, Fake Taxis)
meta.description:
7 tourist scams in Vietnam target visitors every day — money switching, fake taxis, rigged meters. Learn how each works and exactly how to avoid it.

This 7-minute guide breaks down the seven most common tourist scams in Vietnam: money switching with confusing dong notes, fake taxis with rigged meters, shoe-shine and photo traps, market overcharging, cyclo price tricks and short-changing, fake tour agents, and ATM skimmers plus motorbike rental damage claims. For each scam you will see how it works, what it costs, and the exact fix that keeps your money safe.
